blocks.text: Digital entrepreneurship is the use of technology and online platforms to create, manage, and grow business ideas. It helps individuals solve real-world problems through innovative digital solutions. Entrepreneurs use social media, e-commerce websites, and freelancing platforms to reach customers globally. Innovation plays a key role in developing new products and services that meet changing market needs. This field provides opportunities for students to turn creative ideas into successful digital businesses.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Most successful entrepreneurs are not born risk-takers—they develop risk-taking skills through experience.
